body: Chief: P0-3 candidate 7ad7762/e04c66c is BLOCKED (fresh-context review; tests confirmed align 82/82, laws 66/66, fixtures 87/87 — the block is about what the proof proves, not about failures). HIGH: validated proves mass/flow/cost/viterbi ⊆ admissibility, but admissibility is caller-supplied and Admissibility has public apply/of/faithfulOnly (align/cost.scala:394-420). Probe compiled in the laws package: AlignmentRow.of + AlignmentMatrix.of + validated(..., Map(u -> Map(ref -> Admissibility.faithfulOnly)), 0) returns Right with faithfulMass=1.0 and RecallSignature.compute accepts it — ModeGate never ran. The original P0 repro shifted by one field; PopulationSuite.scala:184-187 in the candidate does exactly this. REQUIRED: the proof must be anchored in ModeGate — validated takes (recall, view) and checks admissibility(u)(ref) == ModeGate.assess(unit, view.node(ref), view) for every anchor carrying mass/cost/path; AND make Admissibility's constructor/of/faithfulOnly private[align] so a record can only originate in ModeGate (tests fabricate via ModeGate over a fixture, never by hand). MEDIUM, same slice: rows must be normalized (|Σ−1| ≤ a stated constant, e.g. 1e-9) and flow step marginals must match adjacent rows within the same tolerance — a legal-state flow with arbitrary mass currently drives the ordering metrics (signature.scala:96-112). LOW, same slice: gate on key presence, not m > 0 (hsmm.scala:206-215) — population.sourceRefs and AlignmentRow.argmax read keys regardless of mass. Also: fix the false 'cannot be minted' comment at density.scala:102-105 (or route densities through HsmmResult / an explicit ablation type); LawsSuite.scala:22-38 must assert the error message contains 'cannot be accessed', not just errors.nonEmpty; stale 'assume-skipped' prose at WarOfTheGhostsAlignmentSuite.scala:18. Codec note for codex-storymodel4s-root: no HsmmResult/AlignmentMatrix codec exists yet; when added, decode must call validated WITH the view. Repost the candidate when done; I will re-review the same way.
